command_policy: Each trial currently supports exactly one actual atomic command record. Its command equals trial.command. Composite records are rejected.

counts.stack: Nonnegative integer after accepted Qed. Null when the open-proof public API cannot expose hidden frames.

final_obligations.method: Filtered closure uses kernel-accepted-Qed and the exact same-session accepted operation.
final_obligations.undefined_evars: exact integer count, or null when unavailable

coverage.actual_triggers: nonnegative integer counts of qualifying triggers by selected rule
coverage.attempted_entries: nonnegative integer counts of all native attempts by selected rule
coverage.captured_events: same map as actual_triggers and exact retained point counts
coverage.instruction_provenance_complete: False when a native checkpoint lacks its canonical PC or exact state attribution. An unavailable value is distinct from an absent event.
coverage.unknown_guards: Nonnegative counts by selected rule. Any unknown guard prevents completeness.

required_checks: Bind the unchanged raw SESSION hash and exact REQUEST hash.
Recompute the logical session and match the accepted proof start.
Match native RUN-MANIFEST revisions and instrumentation.
Verify every owned Pet event against the raw index.
Verify every process stream and file against the complete RAW-SEAL.
Match raw attempted and actual counts to coverage and retained point identities.
Reject completeness when any raw trigger classification is unknown.
Derive every schema2 classification from its exact guard-counter bytes.
Join every actual guard to its exact native capture identity.
Require every declared trial and its exact entry, trial and rollback snapshots.
Join accepted Qed to its same-session command, source-state chain, accepted response, final state and empty obligations.
Keep public Pet.state_hash equality separate from full discarded-trial snapshot equality.
Verify every bounded chunk and reconstruct complete logical content without truncation.

identity.switches: requested assignments and separately measured ordered actual instances

identity_policy: The identity root, source path, source SHA, statement SHA and retained prefix equal request.scope.
omitted_metadata: The complete required live Evd subset includes contexts, types, bodies, status, filters and candidates. Universe constraints, source locations, relevance and abstraction metadata remain unavailable.

packages.legacy: The separate zesu-signature-gates.trace-observer package retains accepted026.

physical_records.limit_scope: Every observer record includes its metadata and JSON encoding overhead. Goals, live Evd, feedback, refusals and residual Show Proof use the same lossless format.

residual_null_policy: residual is null only when traversal establishes proof closure. Empty printed groups alone do not establish closure.

residual_trial_policy.coverage: Residual trials do not add native triggers or repair missing instrumentation.
residual_trial_policy.execution: SDK-discarded. No native rule entry is inferred.
residual_trial_policy.full_state: Before and rollback captures match completely, including both printers, live Evd, fresh counter, and Show Proof. They can expose more peers than the first selected-leaf capture.
residual_trial_policy.operation_join: The same SESSION binds adjacent full-before, discarded-command, and full-rollback operations. Their paths remain inside its evidence root.
residual_trial_policy.refused_after: The discarded partial state remains unavailable. The restored rollback snapshot supplies the after pointer with an explicit status.
residual_trial_policy.selection: The exact first focused leaf ID must match SESSION.residual_selection and SESSION.residual_event.

runtime_evidence: fixed relative sidecar path only; runtime hashes belong in the separate evidence seal
selected_point_policy: Retain every actual selected-rule trigger in observed order.
Retain the first residual with complete Show Proof.
Retain only snapshots referenced by selected trials and the first residual.
Keep every other event and the instruction lists in the hashed raw sidecar.
Require attempted_entries >= actual_triggers = entry_events = captured_events for each selected rule.
Unknown classification makes trace completeness false.

session.id: stable logical session identifier derived from bound inputs

snapshot_association_policy: The first command before pointer names the trial before snapshot.
The final command after pointer names the trial after_trial snapshot.
Each later command before pointer equals the previous command after pointer.
The rollback snapshot equals the entry snapshot.
The entry snapshot retains the actual rule point goals, contexts, live Evd, shelf and given-up data.
snapshot_policy: Every command pointer resolves inside snapshots. Snapshots contain actual observed before/after states. A failed trial may point to its observed restored state and must record that limit.

<stable-snapshot-id>.goal_nonotation: complete no-notation text of the same goal, or null under the same condition

success_policy.proof_closure: The owned whole-proof Qed succeeds. The final obligation record is complete and contains zero goals, zero stack goals, zero shelf goals, zero given-up goals and zero undefined evars.
success_policy.rule_success: An accepted whole-rule entry trial defines all exact entry goal evars, introduces no new remaining undefined evars, and discharges the targeted goals. Earlier identified obligations may remain. Bind the exact trial and both live Evd snapshots.
success_policy.unresolved: The available evidence establishes neither supported success kind. Unsupported supplied terminal claims make trace completeness false.

Qed.evidence: pointer to the accepted same-session operation

context.hyps: exact ordered named hypotheses with complete statements and definitions
context.point: RFC6901 pointer to the exact trigger point
context.sha256: SHA256 of the context hyps canonical JSON: sorted maps, indent 2, UTF-8, final newline
context.snapshot: RFC6901 pointer to the same-session live entry snapshot

negated_clause.trial: RFC6901 pointer to the same-session exposed-clause trial

unsupported_refutation_record.policy: Reject refutation claims until the full statement/context/session/hash/Qed/assumption/closure validator exists.
unsupported_refutation_record.session: same logical session id as the point and trial
unsupported_refutation_record.statement: literal proved declaration with explicit binders: <point hypotheses> ⊢ ¬ <clause side condition>
unsupported_refutation_record.statement_sha256: SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 statement bytes without normalization

verdict.evidence: RFC6901 pointer to validated terminal success, or null
verdict.session: same logical session id as the top-level session and every point

terminal_check.target_discharge: Every exact entry goal id is defined and absent from after current/shelf/given-up goals. Every remaining goal has an exact id.

verdict_policy: Only actual-success and unresolved are supported. actual-success carries rule_success or proof_closure. An unresolved verdict carries kind null. Every supplied success claim must match the independently derived evidence, scope, kind and session. Refutation claims remain unsupported.
